statement: Repodaki sistemlerin hepsi kusursuz organize bağlanacak ve kusursuz hizmet verecek: güvenli, performanslı, multi-tenant, üretimde olan bir yazılımın endüstriyel şekilde hatasız olması ve üstün kod kalitesi.

dimensions.rationale: Contract parity, schema ownership and NATS identity all vote inside these lanes; a dimension may not invent a measurement that already has a gate.
The hourly probe is the only mechanism that observes the RUNNING product rather than the repository.
Dependabot severity counts join this dimension when the E23 authority gate opens; until then a red scanner is the honest signal ARIA owns.
Tenant-schema routing and RLS invariants run here; the tenant-scoping adapter's findings feed the same dimension once its class verdicts land (CE-1).

dimensions.operator_words: üretimde olan bir yazılımın endüstriyel şekilde hatasız olması
dimensions.rationale: Production integrity is proven by the lanes that touch production, not by repository tests.
Lint, type and test verdicts for the kernel; the product-side equivalents ride CI - Full under connection_integrity.
